name: spark-hud
description: An animated HUD above the Claude Code prompt: context window, plan limits (5h/7d) with burn-rate pace, cost, live subagents and your other Claude Code windows.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: full: smooth while Claude works, 1 redraw/s at rest. calm: slower motion. off: no motion, a redraw every 15 s at rest.

shareWithOtherWindows.title: Show your other windows
shareWithOtherWindows.description: Each window writes a tiny status file (folder name, model, context %, busy or idle, bare tool name) to ~/.claude/spark-hud/sessions so the others can list it. Never commands, paths, prompts or output. Off: nothing is written or read.
